questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "DILIGENT"
questions.explanation: DILIGENT का अर्थ होता है मेहनती या परिश्रमी। Synonym: Industrious, Hardworking, Assiduous.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "DILIGENT"
questions.explanation: DILIGENT (परिश्रमी) का Antonym है Indolent (कामचोर) या Lazy (आलसी).

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "COMPASSIONATE"
questions.explanation: COMPASSIONATE का अर्थ होता है दयालु या करुणामयी। Synonym: Merciful, Kind, Sympathetic.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "COMPASSIONATE"
questions.explanation: COMPASSIONATE (दयालु) का Antonym है Unfeeling (निर्दयी) या Cruel.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "DOCILE"
questions.explanation: DOCILE का अर्थ होता है विनम्र, आज्ञाकारी या सीधा-साधा। Synonym: Submissive, Obedient, Compliant.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "DOCILE"
questions.explanation: DOCILE (आज्ञाकारी) का Antonym है Stubborn (जिद्दी) या Unruly (अनियंत्रित).

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "EXQUISITE"
questions.explanation: EXQUISITE का अर्थ होता है उत्कृष्ट, सुंदर या अति-नाजुक। Synonym: Delicate, Beautiful, Fine.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "EXQUISITE"
questions.explanation: EXQUISITE (उत्कृष्ट/सुंदर) का Antonym है Crude (भद्दा/कच्चा) या Ugly.

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A large enclosure, cage or building for keeping and rearing birds"
questions.explanation: पक्षियों को रखने के विशाल पिंजरे/स्थान को Aviary पक्षीशाला कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A place where bees are kept and honey is produced"
questions.explanation: मधुमक्खियों के पालन स्थान को Apiary कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "One who always expects the best possible outcome and looks at the bright side"
questions.explanation: आशावादी व्यक्ति को Optimist कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "One who always expects the worst and looks at the dark side of life"
questions.explanation: निराशावादी व्यक्ति को Pessimist कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A person who believes that all events are predetermined by fate or destiny"
questions.explanation: भाग्यवादी (भाग्य में विश्वास रखने वाले) व्यक्ति को Fatalist कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Break the ice"
options: Initiate conversation in a quiet or awkward environment
questions.explanation: Break the ice = चुप्पी तोड़ना, बातचीत शुरू करना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Burn the midnight oil"
options: To burn a house at night
To sleep late in the morning
Study or work late into the night
questions.explanation: Burn the midnight oil = देर रात तक मेहनत/पढ़ाई करना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Bite the bullet"
options: Face a difficult situation with courage and fortitude
questions.explanation: Bite the bullet = कठिन परिस्थिति का हिम्मत से मुकाबला करना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Call it a day"
options: Stop working on a task for the remainder of the day
questions.explanation: Call it a day = दिन का काम समाप्त करना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Cry over spilt milk"
options: Regret or complain about something in the past that cannot be changed
questions.explanation: Cry over spilt milk = जो बीत गया उस पर व्यर्थ में पछताना।

questions.question: Identify the segment with an ERROR: "He is one of the best student in our school."
questions.explanation: Rule: 'One of the' के बाद हमेशा प्लुरल नाउन ('students') का प्रयोग होता है।

questions.question: Identify the segment with an ERROR: "Neither the teacher nor the students was present today."
questions.explanation: Rule: Neither...nor में निकटतम सब्जेक्ट ('students' प्लुरल) के अनुसार प्लुरल वर्ब 'were' आएगी।

questions.question: Identify the segment with an ERROR: "I have been waiting for you since two hours."
questions.explanation: Rule: अवधि ('two hours') के साथ प्रपोजिशन 'for' आता है (for two hours).

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: "He is senior _____ all his colleagues in age."
questions.explanation: Rule: Senior, Junior, Superior आदि के साथ प्रपोजिशन 'to' आता है ('than' नहीं).

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: "She prefers coffee _____ tea in winter."
questions.explanation: Rule: Verb 'Prefer' के साथ हमेशा 'to' प्रपोजिशन प्रयुक्त होता है।

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: "The cat jumped _____ the wall smoothly."
questions.explanation: Rule: दीवार के ऊपर से होकर कूदने के लिए 'over' का प्रयोग होता है।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "FRUGAL"
questions.explanation: FRUGAL का अर्थ होता है मितव्ययी या किफायती। Synonym: Economical, Thrifty.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "FRUGAL"
questions.explanation: FRUGAL (किफायती) का Antonym है Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च करने वाला) या Wasteful.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "GARRULOUS"
questions.explanation: GARRULOUS का अर्थ होता है बातूनी या वाचाल। Synonym: Loquacious, Talkative.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "GARRULOUS"
questions.explanation: GARRULOUS (बातूनी) का Antonym है Taciturn (कम बोलने वाला) या Reticent.

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A system of government ruled by the wealthy and rich class"
questions.explanation: धनी वर्ग के शासन को Plutocracy कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A system of government by state officials or non-elected bureaucrats"
questions.explanation: अफसरशाही/नौकरशाही को Bureaucracy कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A system of government by a single individual with unlimited power"
questions.explanation: निरंकुश एकतंत्र शासन को Autocracy कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A system of government by the whole population or elected representatives"
questions.explanation: जनता द्वारा चुने गए प्रतिनिधियों के शासन को Democracy (लोकतंत्र) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Facing the music"
options: Accepting the negative consequences of one's actions
questions.explanation: Facing the music = परिणाम भुगतना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Hit the nail on the head"
options: To hit one's finger with a hammer
To make a mistake in building
Do or say something with exact correctness
questions.explanation: Hit the nail on the head = सटीक बात कहना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "In the nick of time"
options: Just in time at the last possible moment
questions.explanation: In the nick of time = ठीक एन समय पर।

questions.question: Select the correct improvement for the underlined part: "Hardly had I arrived <u>than</u> the train left."
questions.explanation: Rule: 'Hardly' के साथ कंजंक्शन 'when' आता है ('than' गलत है).

questions.question: Select the correct improvement for the underlined part: "If I <u>was</u> a bird, I would fly to you."
questions.explanation: Rule: काल्पनिक शर्त वाले वाक्यों में सब्जेक्ट के साथ सदैव 'were' प्रयुक्त होता है।

questions.question: Change into PASSIVE VOICE: "He wrote a letter."
options: A letter is written by him.
A letter was written by him.
A letter was being written by him.
A letter has been written by him.
questions.explanation: Past Simple का Passive = Object + was/were + V3 + by + Subject.

questions.question: Change into PASSIVE VOICE: "They are playing football."
options: Football has been played by them.
Football is being played by them.
questions.explanation: Present Continuous का Passive = Object + is/am/are + being + V3 + by + Subject.

questions.question: Change into INDIRECT SPEECH: He said, "I am going to market."
options: He told that he is going to market.
He asked if he was going to market.
He said that he was going to market.
He said that I am going to market.
questions.explanation: Present Continuous बदलकर Past Continuous (was going) बनता है।

questions.question: Change into INDIRECT SPEECH: She said to me, "What is your name?"
options: She asked me what was my name.
She told me what my name is.
She asked me what is my name.
She asked me what my name was.
questions.explanation: WH- प्रश्न में reporting verb 'asked' बनेगी तथा reported speech 'what my name was' बनेगी।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "HARMONY"
questions.explanation: HARMONY का अर्थ होता है सामंजस्य, तालमेल या एकता। Synonym: Concord, Agreement, Unity.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "HARMONY"
questions.explanation: HARMONY (सामंजस्य) का Antonym है Discord (कलह/असमंजस) या Conflict.

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A sound that is impossible or incapable of being heard"
questions.explanation: अश्रव्य (जो सुनाई न दे) को Inaudible कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "Certain to happen and impossible to be avoided or prevented"
questions.explanation: अपरिहार्य (जिसका होना निश्चित हो और टाला न जा सके) को Inevitable कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "Handwriting or printed text that is impossible to read"
questions.explanation: अपठनीय लिखावट को Illegible कहते हैं।

questions.explanation: सही वर्तनी NEIGHBOUR (पड़ोसी) है।
